title: Concurrent Compliance and Sentiment Analysis
business: Financial institutions requiring rapid document processing.
problem: Sequential processing of high-volume client communications leads to unacceptable latency, as compliance screening and sentiment analysis are performed one after another.
solution: Implementing a Parallel Agent Workflow allows the system to trigger compliance screening and sentiment analysis simultaneously, aggregating both results before finalizing the client response.
steps: Decompose the incoming client communication into independent analysis tasks.
Dispatch the compliance screening task to a dedicated model instance.
Dispatch the sentiment analysis task to a separate model instance concurrently.
Collect the outputs from both model instances once both tasks complete.
Programmatically aggregate the results to determine the final communication strategy.
outcome: Reduced total processing time per communication while maintaining distinct, specialized analysis for both safety and tone.
limitation: Parallelization increases the total number of concurrent LLM calls, which can lead to higher infrastructure costs; monitor this by tracking the aggregate token usage per request.
